newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers 6.0 trln lire medium/long-term paper.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers 6.0 trln lire medium/long-term paper.

text.p: The Italian Treasury said it will issue three, five and 10-year fixed rate bonds (BTP) and seven year floating rate certificates (CCT) at its regular mid-month auction.
The Treasury said in a statement it would offer a total of 6.0 trillion lire:
* 1.5 trln lire 11th tranche 1/10/96 3-yr BTPs paying a 7.50 percent coupon.
* 1.5 trln lire 11th tranche 15/09/96 5-yr BTPs paying 7.75 percent coupon.
* 1.5 trln lire 7th tranche 1/11/96 10-yr BTP paying a 7.75 percent coupon.
* 1.5 trln lire 5th tranche 1/11/96 7-yr CCTs paying an initial 3.80 pct coupon.
Subscriptions for the CCT and 10-year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT December 17.
Subscriptions for the three and five year BTP auctions close at 1200 GMT December 18.
